_help: Fill every empty value, then run: python3 -I fill_policies.py placeholders.json filled   (writes ready-to-publish copies into ./filled and lists anything still unfilled). Leave a value empty to keep that token unfilled.
_effective_date_note: Leave empty to use the date you run the script. Use the actual publication date.
_domain_note: Once the domain is cleared and bought, e.g. example.in. Empty email fields below are derived from it as contact@, privacy@, grievance@ and legal@.
_grievance_officer_note: Must be a real, named individual resident in India. This cannot be invented or left generic on the live page.
grievance_hours: 09:00 to 21:00 IST, seven days a week
